set.body:
Add the smallest typed correspondence contract: fixed point, moving point, confidence, midpoint, and verified tangent sign. Preserve the current block search geometry for the first experiment.

Extend matching only with reverse search and soft ambiguity confidence. Confidence combines normalized displacement-distribution entropy with forward/reverse cycle consistency; use soft weights rather than aggressive hard deletion.

Acceptance: pure translation recovers the correct tangent sign in both directions; forward/reverse swaps negate tangents and preserve midpoint/confidence; unique peaks outrank multimodal and cycle-inconsistent matches; flat blocks receive near-zero effective weight; confidence remains finite and bounded; deterministic fixtures pass on JVM and Scala.js; matcher accuracy and runtime are recorded separately from projection and assimilation. Do not add learned features or retune block size/search radius in this gate.
set.title: BasinBridge B1: typed correspondences and ambiguity confidence
